comparison.objective: Unlatch, withdraw, support, and place a named plug-in relay.
comparison.physical_skill: Handle release, connector separation, bimanual load support, and controlled extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Relay is upright on a mat while the other relay remains latched and untouched.
comparison.reason: This is removal and carrying of a compact module; the candidate is installation of a long telescoping rail with four prongs, rack-unit leveling, and fastening. Shared bimanual support does not establish overlap.
